content: Is Kedhukum wey is Hizu te Megbevayà

content.text: Sikiyu is mekeǥeǥehem he menge etew,
maan is ibpehivantug niw is kelelalung niw?
Kenè be layun kew ebpurungi te Megbevayà?
Ebpelenuwan niw is igkezeeti te zuma he etew.
Is menge zilè niw ne iring te meǥarang he kutsilyu su ebpekepalì te ǥehinawa te zuma.
Kedlimbung is layun niw ed-ul-ulaha.
Dekelà diyà te ǥehinawa niw is mezaat kenà is meupiya,
ne ibpelavi niw is kedlalag te tarù kenà te kedlalag te tutuu.
Sikiyu is menge limbungan, utew niw igkesuat is kebpesekiti niw te zuma pinaaǥi te menge lalag niw.
Siguradu he edezeetan kew te Megbevayà te wazà pidtemanan.
Edekepen kew zin ne eguyuzen kew zin pehendiyà te ǥawas te valey niw.
Ne edhewien din is untung niw.
Egkaahà heini te menge metazeng, ne egkeinuinu sikandan.
Ne ed-engit sikandan is egkaǥi te,
“Ahaa niw is menge etew he kenà edsarig te Megbevayà he melig-en pezem he eputè dan.
Su iyan dan edseriǥan is mahabet he menge azen dan,
ne mid-iseg is kegkemekeǥeǥehem dan pinaaǥi te kedezaat dan te zuma he etew.”
Piru siak mulà egkeiring a te kayu he ulibu he ziyà meketuvù te valey te Megbevayà.
Edseriǥan ku is kebmahala zin kedì te wazà pidtemanan.
He Megbevayè ku, ebpeselamatan ku sikew te taman te taman tenged te mibeelan nu.
Edsarig a kenikew su ebpurungan nu is metinumanen he menge etew nu.
